gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite, ChatGPT's 'best premium' pick, sends its BMS data only as CAN bus at 500 kbit/s to a Victron GX device (Cerbo GX, Ekrano GX, Cerbo GX Mk2). Its page names no RS485 and no other inverter brand, while the EG4 LifePower4 V2 and Pytes E-Box 48100R have both CAN and RS485 ports and let you pick the inverter protocol. So on a non-Victron hybrid inverter the Epoch cannot run closed-loop, and the inverter has to be programmed by hand.
standout_why: Compared against: liveoffthegrid.com/specs/batteries (cited). It has a comms column that says only 'CAN/RS485' for EG4 and Pytes, does not list Epoch, and says it has 'no compatibility list, and no inverter pairing guidance'. ownyourelectricity.com/articles/48-volt-lithium-battery says 'The battery BMS must communicate with your hybrid inverter' but names no protocol and does not cover Epoch. wildjoule.com/best-48v-off-grid-battery says EG4 V2 has 'closed-loop communication with most major inverters' but does not mention Epoch or Victron-only comms. The cited EG4 V2 spec-sheet PDF came back as binary and I could not read it, so I can't rule out that it lists inverter brands. No page I read says the Epoch talks only to a Victron GX device. gearranking.com failed with an SSL error and was not checked.
decides: The finding decides the pick by inverter brand. Shoppers with a Victron MultiPlus or Quattro and a GX device get full closed-loop control (DVCC) from the Epoch. Anyone on an EG4, Sol-Ark, Growatt, Luxpower or Sun Gold Power hybrid should take the EG4 LifePower4 V2 or the Pytes E-Box 48100R: both have CAN and RS485 with a selectable protocol (EG4 sets it with a Protocol 6 DIP switch or P06-LUX; Pytes posts setup videos for Sol-Ark, SMA, Victron, Growatt, Luxpower and others). The Epoch also now costs $2,599, not the $2,399 ChatGPT showed. It is rated 80 A continuous, cannot be wired in series, and its page lists only cell- and fuse-level UL listings, not a whole-pack UL 1973.

findings.label: Inverter communication link
findings.value: CAN bus at 500 kbit/s to a compatible Victron GX device (Cerbo GX, Ekrano GX, Cerbo GX Mk2), 'Victron-ready communication with DVCC support'. No RS485 or other inverter brand named. Fallback is programming MultiPlus/Quattro by hand.
findings.source_title: Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite LiFePO4 | Victron, Heated, BT
findings.note: Maker's product page. Also says to set the VE.Can port speed on the GX to 500 kbit/s.

findings.source_title: Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite LiFePO4 | Victron, Heated, BT

findings.label: BMS continuous current
findings.value: 80 A continuous discharge (250 A for 10 s). 80 A continuous charge from all sources combined (90 A for 5 s).
findings.source_title: Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite LiFePO4 | Victron, Heated, BT
findings.note: 80 A × 51.2 V ≈ 4.1 kW continuous per battery.

findings.label: Series / parallel limits
findings.value: Up to 16 in parallel (1,600 Ah, 81.92 kWh). Series and series-parallel not supported.
findings.source_title: Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite LiFePO4 | Victron, Heated, BT

findings.label: Safety listings stated
findings.value: UL 1642, UL 9540A and IEC 62619:2022 cells, plus a UL 60691 internal fuse. No whole-pack UL 1973 listed.
findings.source_title: Epoch 48V 100Ah V2-T Elite LiFePO4 | Victron, Heated, BT
findings.note: Lists cell and component listings only. Also IP67 and internal heating (charges down to -30 °C ambient when charge current is available).

findings.label: Communication ports and protocol selection
findings.value: CAN bus and RS485 ports plus a new Protocol 6 DIP switch. Closed-loop supported with up to 64 batteries in parallel (327.7 kWh).
findings.source_title: Introducing the EG4 LifePower4 48V V2 Battery
findings.note: Maker announcement dated 2024-08-20. It says the CAN port allows 'a wider range of inverters without needing a Communication Hub' but names no brands.

findings.label: Auto-ID (IN-03) and certifications
findings.value: Auto-ID adds automatic addressing that simplifies closed-loop setup 'with other EG4 batteries and inverters'. UL 1973, UL 9540A, UL 9540 pending. 10-year warranty. 100 A internal BMS.
findings.source_title: EG4 LiFePower4 48V v2 100Ah Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery
findings.note: Maker page covers models SR-48-100-LP4-IN-02 and -IN-03, SKU EG4LP48V100AV2. The IN-02 listing at signaturesolar.com shows 'Currently unavailable' (read 2026-11-08). That listing says 'UL1973 Recognized Component … UL9540 Listed with EG4 18kPV-12LV'.

findings.label: Closed-loop protocol setting
findings.value: Set the master battery's CAN protocol to 'P06-LUX'; the setting on the master alone covers the whole bank. Use 'EG4' for older EG4 inverters. Set the inverter's battery type to Lithium.
findings.source_title: Unlocking Seamless Communication: A BMS Setup Guide for EG4 Batteries and Inverters
findings.note: Maker guide dated 2023-11-20. The P06-LUX and 'EG4' settings are shown for the LL-S and WallMount batteries with the 6000XP and 18kPV. The LifePower4 is shown set to master with the 6000XP. Only EG4 inverters are covered.

findings.label: Communication and inverter integrations
findings.value: CAN/RS485. 'Compatible with most inverter brands'. Integration videos for Sol-Ark, SMA, Must, SRNE, Victron, MPP Solar, Megarevo, Luxpower and Growatt. Up to 96 in parallel.
findings.note: Maker page. Case studies also mention Solis and Deye.

findings.label: Listings, cycles, warranty
findings.value: UL9540 Ed.2 (2020), UL9540A, UL1973, CEC, SGIP, IEC62619, UN38.3. ≥6,000 cycles at 0.5C, 25 °C, 90% DoD. 10-year warranty. 51.2 V nominal (47.5–57.6 V).
findings.note: Maker page gives an ambient range of -10 to 50 °C but no separate charge-temperature range.

findings.label: Rival coverage of BMS–inverter comms
findings.value: Comms column definition only: 'A supported protocol lets the battery manage its own charge profile and report real state of charge to the inverter.' No pairing or compatibility guidance.
findings.source_title: LiFePO4 batteries compared: specs, limits, and price
findings.note: The rival page ChatGPT cited. Epoch is not in its 48 V rows.
